facts.fact: Times of Eswatini reports a national e-KYC system, set to roll out soon, to digitise identity verification for financial services, with commercial banks, financial service providers, regulators and ministries meeting to coordinate implementation of the national e-KYC registry and the Royal Science and Technology Park providing the infrastructure for a national identity verification platform; the article does not say the platform checks against the national ID database.

systems.platform: national identity verification platform / e-KYC registry
systems.tiers: Royal Science and Technology Park provides infrastructure
